label: Selected-content truth-class equivalence and factive profile discrimination
paraphrase: Analyst relational diagnostic: for an arbitrary selected Boolean content family, complete positive/negative knowledge at a world is equivalent to its epistemic alternatives agreeing on that family's truth profile. Reflexive complete worlds differing on a selected truth cannot have identical epistemic extensions. Thus equal supplied intrinsic-state or hard-past projections plus extension supervenience contradict such discrimination. Neither projection bridge is asserted of God.
